function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command in the agent's home directory. Use this for file operations, git, running scripts, and inspecting the system. Prefer read_file/write_file for file content; use bash for directory listings, git, and commands.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Use this to inspect code, configs, or notes.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative path to the file.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates parent directories if needed.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative path to the file.
